description: If \(H_L\) is nonempty, \(T_\Gamma\) is unsatisfiable exactly when some finite subset of its propositional ground-instance theory \(G_\Gamma\) is unsatisfiable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.finite_ground_obstruction.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [Nonempty (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.GroundTerm L)]
  (Γ : Set (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.Matrix L)) :
  ¬(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.universalTheory Γ).IsSatisfiable ↔
    ∃ Δ,
      ↑Δ ⊆ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.groundTheory Γ ∧
        ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Satisfiable Δ
